Its defensive capabilities are comparable to those of a metal shield's.|Inventory|BotW}} Guardian Shields+ go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 30 |durability = 13 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Shield+}} Guardian Shields+ are wielded by [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]] within "A Moderate Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Guardian Shield+. They are larger versions of [[Guardian Shield]]s with a boosted output level. They belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} In terms of defensive abilities, they are considered to be on par with metal Shields. Like other variations of Guardian Shields, Guardian Shields+ are capable of reflecting the beams of [[Guardian Scout]]s and other Guardians. As they are made from [[Ancient Technology]], Guardian Shields+ will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Unlike metal Shields, they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]] like wooden Shields. They also cannot be manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_014" |Life = 13 |GuardPower = 30 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 11 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 1 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Guardian Shields+ can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Guardian Sword+|Guardian Swords+]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Guardian Gear * Guardian Shield * Guardian Shield++ * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Guardian Gear, Shields |items= BotW, AoC }}
